$comment: Everything tokens.json needs that theme.css does not state: themes, usage notes, type styles, shadows. Values of colours, spacing-ui-height, radius, font families and z-index layers are read from packages/ui/src/theme.css by build.ts.
name: Chunks UI

colorUsage.primary: Brand blue. Fills of primary Button, IconButton and Chip; checked Checkbox, Radio and Switch; Slider range; Progress indicator; the selected Calendar day. Same value in both themes.
colorUsage.primary-foreground: Text and icons on a `primary` fill (4.5:1 in both themes).
colorUsage.success: Positive actions: success Button, IconButton and Chip. Never as text: about 2:1 on white; text uses the derived `text-success-text`.
colorUsage.success-foreground: Text on a `success` fill. Dark ink, because the fill is light.
colorUsage.warning: Caution: warning Button, IconButton and Chip. As text, use the derived `text-warning-text`.
colorUsage.warning-foreground: Text on a `warning` fill. Dark ink, because the fill is light.
colorUsage.destructive: Errors and deletions: destructive Button, IconButton and Chip; invalid Input and Textarea borders; ClearButton hover. As text, use the derived `text-destructive-text`.
colorUsage.destructive-foreground: Text on a `destructive` fill (4.5:1 in both themes).
colorUsage.background: Page ground, and the surface of Dialog, Drawer, Input, Textarea, Select and Combobox triggers, the active Tabs tab and ToggleGroup item.
colorUsage.foreground: Body text and icons on `background`, `card` and `popover`.
colorUsage.popover: Surface of Popover, Menu, Select and Combobox popups, the DatePicker popup and Toast.
colorUsage.secondary: Neutral fill of secondary Button, IconButton and Chip.
colorUsage.muted: Subdued surfaces: Tabs list track, Skeleton, Progress and Slider tracks, Avatar fallback, Table header and row hover (`bg-muted/50`), ScrollArea thumb.
colorUsage.muted-foreground: Secondary text on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted`: descriptions, placeholders, Field.Description, Breadcrumb links, inactive tabs (4.5:1 in both themes).
colorUsage.accent: Hover and highlighted item background in Menu, Select, Combobox, Calendar, Pagination; text and IconButton hover.
colorUsage.border: Hairlines: Card, Separator, Table rows, Accordion items, popup and Dialog outlines, outlined secondary buttons.
colorUsage.input: Borders of form controls: Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, NumberField, DatePicker trigger, unchecked Checkbox, Radio and Switch track.
colorUsage.chart-1: Chart series 1 (shadcn compat; no component uses it).

spacingUsage.spacing-ui-height: Height of every control (Button, Input, Select, NumberField, Tabs list…), `h-ui-height`. `--spacing-ui-icon-height` is half of it.

radiusUsage.radius: Base radius (10px); the scale derives from it: `rounded-sm` = radius − 4px (6px, Menu and Select items), `rounded-md` = radius − 2px (8px, controls and popups), `rounded-lg` = radius (10px, Tabs track), `rounded-xl` = radius + min(radius, 4px) (14px, Card and Dialog).

zIndexNote: Layer order from theme.css (`@theme inline`, so the utilities hold these numbers).

zIndexUsage.z-index-dropdowns: `z-dropdowns`: Select, Combobox, Menu, Popover and DatePicker popups.
zIndexUsage.z-index-overlays: `z-overlays`: unused by components; free for your overlays above popups, below drawers.
zIndexUsage.z-index-notifications: `z-notifications`: unused by components; free for banners and notices.

shadow.note: Tailwind v4 defaults that the components use; theme.css defines no shadows of its own.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Switch thumb, Slider thumb, the active Tabs tab and ToggleGroup item.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Popups: Menu, Select, Combobox, Popover, DatePicker, Tooltip.

styles.name: text-lg
styles.usage: Titles of Card, Dialog, Drawer and Empty (`text-lg font-semibold`; in `font-heading` when you set `--font-heading`).

styles.name: text-base
styles.sample: Body copy on the page ground.
styles.usage: Body copy; the page default from preflight.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Controls and labels: Button, Label, Tabs, Menu items, Pagination, Accordion triggers (`text-sm`, `font-medium`). The most used size in the library.

styles.name: text-sm-regular
styles.sample: We will email you a link.
styles.usage: Descriptions: Field.Description, Card.Description, Toast description, in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Chip text, Calendar weekday headers, Tooltip text, Menu and Select group labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: `font-mono` (Fira Code): code in your app. No component sets it.
